messages:
rene: Heads-up: during sample-app walkthrough I noticed auth retry logs include user emails and partial JWTs when RW_LOG_LEVEL=debug. Repro on Node SDK v0.9.4 locally.

tania: can you paste the exact line?

rene: sure, redacted minimal line copied from local dev console: [ERROR] auth.retry id=req_321 token=eyJhbGciOi... user=alex.k@example.com err=401

tania: thanks. sounds like our redaction middleware isn't invoked for thrown errors bubbled from the retry wrapper. we sanitize responses but not Error objects.

omar: also noticed that for websocket / stream handlers the Otel spans don't get the request id attribute. we only call tracer.setAttribute in http middleware. streams skip it.
tania: proposed fixes: (1) move redaction to the logging layer so everything passes through sanitizer before serialization, (2) add error-object sanitizer that scrubs known keys (email, token, ssn) and masks JWT-looking strings, (3) ensure a request_id is injected and mapped to otel attribute `rw.request_id` for all transport handlers.

rene: small config suggestion for sample app README:
```json
{
  "telemetry.redact": true,
  "telemetry.redact_patterns": ["email", "jwt", "ssn"],
  "telemetry.request_id_header": "x-rw-request-id",
  "telemetry.log_level_env": "RW_LOG_LEVEL"
}
```

omar: +1. Implementation notes: for pino users the sanitizer must run before pino serializes `err` to avoid leaking in `err.stack`. for winston/loglevel wrap the logger creation. also provide RW_SAFE_DEMO env that forces INFO level and auto-redacts for demo environments.

tania: tests: add unit asserting errors go through sanitizer and integration that starts sample app, triggers auth failure, and asserts no email-like patterns appear in captured logs at INFO/ERROR. Also assert Otel span for stream handler contains `rw.request_id`.

ci-bot: created ticket SDK-telemetry-890: "sampleapp: logging redaction + request_id propagation" assigned to tania/omar

rene: thanks. can one of you review a small PR if i open it today? target patch release before next onboarding run.

omar: i can review after standup.

telemetry-bot: FYI: added label PII and security-review required.
